crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed. Take all the warriors with you, and arise, go up to Ai.…
Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him…
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.

translations.web: and you shall rise up from the ambush, and take possession of the city; for Yahweh your God will deliver it into your hand.
translations.bsb: you are to rise from the ambush and seize the city, for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.
translations.kjv: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.
translations.asv: and ye shall rise up from the ambush, and take possession of the city: for Jehovah your God will deliver it into your hand.
